name: Shoku Shussannin Ayana
source:
Ayana Kirisaki is a hentai girl who love masturbating. She trains herself to be a kunoichi.
She arrives at "tentacle planet" by the malfunction of the space ship. There she figures out that she is not a human of the Earth but an extinct alien called "tentacle mother." Ayana decides to stand up to save the tentacle planet and tentacle galaxy!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
雾崎绫奈是一位喜欢自慰的无尽女孩。她将自己训练成女忍者。
她因宇宙飞船故障来到“触手星球”。在那里，她发现自己不是地球上的人类，而是一个被称为“触手母亲”的已灭绝外星人。阿亚娜决定挺身而出，拯救触手星球和触手星系！
